== Description ==
Meet the farmers in Hay Day from all around the world! 

In this 7th episode of the series you'll get to meet Ruud, from Arnhem, Netherlands

Get to see how this Hay Day YouTuber lives his day to day along his cute dog Bailey, riding his bike through the streets of Arnhem and enjoying being part of the Hay Day community.

Subscribe to his YouTube Channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCqwRQt4TU5__p75dsQPS4hg/
